description: This file declares the GpuVideoDecodeAccelerator class, which manages GPU-accelerated video decoding, including initialization, handling decode commands, and interfacing with GPU and media components. It is part of Chromium's media GPU IPC service.

classes.name: GpuVideoDecodeAccelerator
classes.description: Manages GPU-accelerated video decoding, handles IPC messages, manages textures, and interfaces with GPU and media components.

methods.name: GetCapabilities
methods.description: Static method to query supported video decode capabilities based on GPU preferences and workarounds.

methods.name: NotifyInitializationComplete
methods.description: Notifies that the initialization of the decoder is complete with a status.

methods.name: ProvidePictureBuffers
methods.description: Provides picture buffers with specified parameters.

methods.name: DismissPictureBuffer
methods.description: Dismisses a picture buffer by ID.

methods.name: PictureReady
methods.description: Indicates a picture is ready for display.

methods.name: NotifyEndOfBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Signals the end of a bitstream buffer.

methods.name: OnWillDestroyStub
methods.description: Handles the destruction of the GPU command buffer stub.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the VDA with a given configuration and IPC channels.

methods.name: OnReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Handles reuse of a picture buffer.
